# burman-concordance fixtures

Real head slice of Annie Burman's "Digital Concordance of Etruscan,
Faliscan and Early Latin Inscriptions from Etruria" v1.0.0 (Uppsala),
Zenodo record 7801485, retrieved 2026-08-17 from the record's CSV file
(license: Public Domain / CC0 per the deposit + in-record
legalcode.txt). Header + the first seven data rows verbatim, plus the
first two CIE-less rows found in file order (TM-anchored rows whose
inscription carries no CIE number — the unmapped-counted class).
Semicolon-separated; identity columns: Trismegistos, CIE, Rix ET1,
Meiser ET2, TLE, Bakkum, CIL I/I(2)/III/VI/XI, CII (+Suppl./App).
